items.statement: Before implementing process analytical technology, the firm may submit a supplement (Changes Being Effected, CBE-30 or Prior Approval Supplement) to FDA.
items.quote: A supplement (Changes Being Effected (CBE), CBE-30, or Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)) can be submitted to the Agency prior to implementation

items.statement: Evaluate, and discuss with FDA, which option is most appropriate for implementing process analytical technology.
items.quote: Manufacturers should evaluate and discuss with the Agency the most appropriate option for PAT implementation

items.statement: When assessing the risk of microbial contamination of topical antiseptics, consider that components or products stored in open bins may be contaminated by spore-forming microbes (for example Bacillus cereus), by Serratia species and by other airborne microbes.
items.quote: Components or products stored in open bins can be at risk for contamination by spore-forming microbes, such as Bacillus cereus, as well as by Serratia species and other worrisome airborne microbes
items.condition: components or products stored in open bins

items.statement: Assess operations, stay aware of potential risks, and apply appropriate risk management based on an understanding of possible or emerging contamination risks.
items.quote: Manufacturers should assess their operations, be aware of potential risks, and apply appropriate risk management based on an understanding of possible or emerging contamination risks

items.statement: Where leptospiral contamination is considered possible or has occurred, the laboratory should make microscopic examination part of its routine cell culture process control program, as a means of detecting microbial contaminants that may not grow readily on conventional media.
items.quote: the laboratory should ensure that microscopic examination is part of its routine cell culture process control program, as it provides an important means of detecting microbial contaminants that may not readily grow on conventional media.
items.condition: leptospiral contamination considered possible or has occurred

items.statement: Consider adopting more innovative approaches to ensuring that powder blends are adequately mixed.
items.quote: The Agency encourages firms to adopt more innovative approaches to ensuring adequacy of mixing

items.statement: Do not use antimicrobial preservatives as a substitute for good manufacturing practices, solely to reduce the viable microbial population of a nonsterile product, or to control the presterilization bioburden of a multidose formulation during manufacturing.
items.quote: Antimicrobial preservatives should not be used as a substitute for good manufacturing practices, solely to reduce the viable microbial population of a nonsterile product, or control the presterilization bioburden of a multidose formulation during manufacturing.

items.statement: Ensure every sterile drug product batch, whether terminally sterilized or aseptically processed, meets the sterility test requirement before it is released to the market.
items.quote: both terminally sterilized and aseptically processed drug product batches are required to meet the sterility test requirement (see 21 CFR 211.167(a)) before release to the market

items.statement: Do not use for sterile products a container closure system that does not maintain adequate container integrity after it is sealed.
items.quote: a container closure system that does not maintain adequate container integrity after it is sealed is unsuitable for sterile products

items.statement: Implement safeguards that strictly prevent shipment of sterile product that may lack container closure integrity and lead to product nonsterility.
items.quote: safeguards should be implemented to strictly preclude shipment of product that may lack container closure integrity and lead to product nonsterility.
